newsitem.title: USA: American Financial files for $500 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: American Financial files for $500 mln shelf.

text.p: American Financial Group Inc. filed on Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a shelf offering of up to $500 million of debt securities, common stock and preferred securities.

American Financial said the offering may be for unsecured debt securities, which may be etiher senior or subordinated debt securities consisting of debentures, notes and/or evidence of indebtedness, as well as for common stock.
The company said its American Financial Capital Trust II also may offer preferred securities representing undivided beneficial interests in the assets of the trust as part of the shelf offering.
None of the debt securities, common stock or preferred securities will individually exceed an intial public offering price of $200 million, the company said.

Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include investments in insurance businesses and the repayment of outstanding debt of the company and its subsidiaries, it said.
The company did not name underwriters for the offering.
